verdict.rationale: Swell's feature page claims price rules for customer groups such as wholesale accounts and tiered price breaks (swell-docs-16). It also claims you can run wholesale and retail from a single catalog and dashboard (swell-docs-30), which covers group pricing, volume pricing and selling alongside DTC. Nothing in the evidence covers quotes or net-terms invoicing, a central part of B2B selling, and all support comes from marketing pages rather than detailed API docs or hands-on reports. Missing for 10: quote workflows, net-terms/invoice payment, per-customer price lists beyond group rules, detailed developer docs, and independent corroboration.
